hero.title: Share Cloud Native Days Italy
hero.lead: Logos, colors, templates and ready-made assets to talk about the event, the right way, without asking us first.

basics.title: Brand basics
basics.description: The essentials of the Cloud Native Days Italy identity. Use them as they are: no recoloring, no stretching, no remixing.

mediaPartners.title: For media partners
mediaPartners.description: Everything you need to talk about the event on your channels.
offer: Your logo on the website and on the partners wall
A shout-out on our social channels
Ready-made banners and copy for your audience
ask: Share the event with your community
Publish the Call for Papers and ticket announcements
Use the official assets and boilerplate below
mediaPartners.boilerplate: Cloud Native Days Italy is a community-organized event dedicated to cloud native and open source technologies, gathering the Italian community of developers, architects, engineers and IT professionals for two days of talks, workshops and networking. The 2027 edition takes place in Bologna on 20 May 2027. Learn more at cloudnativedaysitaly.org.

attendees.title: For attendees
attendees.description: Coming to the event? Say it loud. Grab an "I'll be there" card for your socials and tag @cloudnativedaysitaly.
attendees.note: An interactive generator to personalize your card is in the works.

speakers.title: For speakers
speakers.description: Selected as a speaker? Congrats! Here is what you need for your talk and your announcement.
guidelines: Use the official slide template, or at least its title and closing slides
16:9 format, minimum 24pt body text: the room is big
Add your social handle on the title slide, the audience will look for you
Live demos welcome, with a recorded backup (conference Wi-Fi is what it is)
speakers.note: Your personalized speaker announcement card is on us: we prepare it and send it to you before the announcement.

usage.title: Usage rules
do: Use the official logos, colors and templates as provided
Pair the logo with generous white space
Tag @cloudnativedaysitaly so we can reshare your posts
dont: Do not recolor, distort, outline or add effects to the logo
Do not use the brand to imply sponsorship or endorsement
Do not alter the templates beyond the marked editable areas
